scripts.setup: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; test -f bosh.env; test -f cf.yml; test -f ops-enable-mtls-app-routing.yml; source bosh.env; : "${BOSH_ENVIRONMENT:?BOSH_ENVIRONMENT is required by bosh.env}"; bosh -n -e "$BOSH_ENVIRONMENT" -d cf deploy cf.yml -o ops-enable-mtls-app-routing.yml; cf create-shared-domain apps.identity --enforce-route-policies --scope any'
